title: First duplicate
prompt: Implement `static int FirstDuplicate(int[] nums)` — return the value whose **second occurrence appears earliest** when scanning left to right; -1 if no value repeats. For [2,1,3,1,2] the answer is 1 (its second occurrence at index 3 beats 2's at index 4).

tests.name: normal
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.FirstDuplicate(new[] { 2, 1, 3, 1, 2 }), 1, "scan order, not value order");
Cj.Eq(Solution.FirstDuplicate(new[] { 5, 5, 5 }), 5, "immediate repeat");
tests.hint: One pass with a set of seen values; the first Add that fails wins.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: No-repeat, empty, and a duplicate separated from its twin.
